name: archgen
description: Monorepo root for archgen — scripts only. Not published; the CLI publishes as archgen-skill and the MCP server as archgen-mcp.
//: Deliberately NOT an npm workspaces root: packages/cli is zero-dep and
packages/mcp keeps its own committed lockfile (the official MCP SDK v2).
Workspaces would hoist/merge lockfiles and break the `npm ci` contract.
Use `npm run setup` once after cloning, then `npm test` runs every suite
The MCP server and the skill require Node >= 20 (the official MCP SDK v2
does). No `version` field on purpose: archgen.config.json is the single
version source (CI vendor-check gates every derived copy). A root version
here would be an ungated drift source.

scripts.test: npm run test:internal && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:cli
scripts.test:fixtures: npm --prefix packages/mcp ci --no-audit --no-fund && bash fixtures/greenfield-demo/run.sh && bash fixtures/brownfield-demo/run.sh && bash fixtures/verifier-negative/run.sh && bash fixtures/tool-matrix/run.sh
